name: IT mints to its pair inside the pair's swap
summary: IT's _transfer, on every transfer out of its IT/USDT pair, mints at least half the transferred amount back to the pair (mintToPoolIfNeeded), and it does so inside the pair's swap before the K check, so the mint counts as IT paid in. From a contract constructor, which passes IT's no-contract check, the attacker repeatedly synced the pair, sent 2,000 USDT and swapped out IT together with more USDT than it paid, draining the pair's USDT.
notes: Reset is setParams (slot 0x19, exchange), 3,182 blocks after deployment: it registered the pair whose outgoing transfers trigger the mint, which the exploit needed (rule 8).

Campaign: every swap on the pair paying out both IT and USDT, scanned from pair creation to block 37300000; the anchor is the first, the four follow-ups are the attacker's (0xb495573c), and three later ones moved under 1 USDT net. Loss is the pair's USDT outflow; its IT is valued at nothing (rule 12).
